lines.text: The LORD will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples, and all who heave it away will be severely injured.
The LORD will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, and He will save their tents first.
They will look on the One they have pierced and mourn as for an only child, with wailing like Hadad-rimmon at Jericho.
A fountain will be opened to the house of David to cleanse them from sin, and the LORD will erase the names of the idols.
Two-thirds in the land will be cut off and perish, but the LORD will refine the remaining third like iron.
